scenes.title: 2018 Dual-EEG Hyperscanning & Coan Handholding Lab: Two Wired Brains Locking Into 8–12 Hz Sync
scenes.era: 2018 CU Boulder / Haifa Dual-EEG Lab & 2006 University of Virginia fMRI Suite

layout.description: Bright high-key clinical neurophysiology room with two oak-arm chairs side-by-side at center: two clothed 48-year-old 2.5D matte cream-white vinyl partners wearing sleek white neural sensor caps clasp hands across the shared wooden armrest while a small smooth forearm thermal pad rests on the left partner's cuff in front of an unmarked dual-wave glass monitor.

positions.who: Pain-test participant (clothed 2.5D matte cream-white vinyl adult with smooth earless noseless hairless oval head and expressive 2D charcoal-black ink eyes, brows, and mouth in dusty-rose knit cardigan, dark slacks, and white neural cap)
positions.where: seated in the left oak armchair with a smooth unmarked thermal cuff on left forearm and right hand resting on the shared wooden armrest
positions.facing: angled slightly toward trusted partner in the right chair

positions.who: Trusted spouse (clothed 2.5D matte cream-white vinyl adult in charcoal wool crew sweater, tailored trousers, and matching white neural cap)
positions.where: seated in the adjacent right oak armchair reaching left hand across the armrest to clasp the participant's hand

props.name: two matched white multi-lead neural sensor caps and smooth forearm thermal pad
props.period_detail: clean clinical dual-EEG hyperscanning caps with bundled white leads and text-free forearm thermode cuff
props.physical_behavior: State-A: hands rest apart while the participant's shoulders tense against forearm heat -> State-B: partner clasps the participant's hand firmly across the oak armrest and tense shoulders drop smoothly

props.name: unmarked dual-channel glass waveform console
props.period_detail: text-free laboratory display showing upper and lower brainwave traces
props.physical_behavior: State-A: two separate jagged out-of-phase traces -> State-B: both traces snap into smooth synchronized cyan-blue 8–12 Hz waves the instant hands clasp

actions.verb_sequence: reaches left hand across the oak chair armrest -> clasps warm fingers firmly over the participant's tense hand -> holds steady as both rear waveform lines lock into sync

reactions.reaction: 2D charcoal-black ink brows soften and raised shoulders drop smoothly as pain drops from 52 down to 25
steady attentive nod mirroring calm breath cadence

scenes.wardrobe: 48-year-old participant in dusty-rose knit cardigan and dark slacks; spouse in charcoal wool crew sweater; clinician in crisp white coat.
scenes.lighting: Bright high-key clinical daylight balanced with soft warm rim light on clasped hands.
scenes.recognition_hook: Sitting inches apart leaves two stressed brains out of sync — until clasping hands locks 8–12 Hz brain waves together and cuts pain in half!

key_visual.description: two adults wearing sleek white neural sensor caps seated side-by-side clasping hands across a wooden chair armrest in front of an unmarked dual-wave clinical monitor

layout.description: Same bright clinical suite with the right companion chair completely empty while the lone participant grips both wooden armrests tightly.

positions.where: seated solo next to a visibly vacant oak companion chair

props.name: slender unmarked ankle sensor cuff and vacant oak companion chair
props.period_detail: minimalist clinical ankle strap beside an empty partner seat
props.physical_behavior: State-A: participant glances at empty chair -> State-B: grips both oak armrests tightly as solo threat circuitry works overtime

actions.verb_sequence: glances sideways at the empty chair -> grips both oak armrests tightly

reactions.reaction: stiffened solo posture illustrating Coan's Social Baseline solitude tax

scenes.wardrobe: Dusty-rose knit cardigan and dark slacks.
scenes.recognition_hook: To the evolved human brain, an empty chair beside you during danger isn't zero — it's an extra fuel tax.
